subject: general
question: Which of the following is considered as the first Vernacular newspaper of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Samachar Darpan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samachar Darpan**

 
 
• **Baptist Missionary** published the Samachar Darpan in** Serampore's Mission Press**.
 
• During** Lord Hastings' administration** (1813 to 1823), it was published.
 
• The **first vernacular newspaper in India was Samachar Darpan**, which was launched on **May 31, 1818**. 
 
• It is regarded as the **very first newspaper** published in the **Indian language**.
 
• It included news** primarily from English newspapers**, but it also included news from other sources.
 
• The newspaper covered the following topics:** births, deaths, and obituaries; government news; news of government officials; news of other European nations besides Britain**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madras Courier**

 
 
• The Madras Courier was **one of the first newspapers in India and the first to be published in Madras, Madras Presidency,** and British India.
 
• Published on** October 12, 1785, it was the top publication** at the time and the one that the government officially designated for printing official notices.
 
 
 
• **Bengal Gazette**
 
 
• The** English-language weekly newspaper** Hicky's Bengal Gazette was published in **Kolkata (then Calcutta)**, the nation's capital of British India.
 
• Between **1780 and 1782, it was the first newspaper printed in Asia** and was in circulation for two years before the East India Company seized the newspaper's printing press and types.
 
 
 
• **Amar Ujala**
 
 
• Established in 1948, Amar Ujala is a daily newspaper in Hindi that is printed in **India**.
 
• There are **21 editions in six states, two union territories, and 180 districts**.
 
• About** two million copies** of it have been distributed.
